scope: Source-only re-review of bounded failure diagnostics around guest SEO metadata-door activation.

evidence: Run 013's saved receipt says its runner was commit 6740fc045d036d4068296da7423186145cecc408; the new diagnostics are in later commit b043645e, so that run did not exercise them.

The preserved run identifies metadata_fixture_schema_outbound_activation as the failure stage and includes the panel's observed schema anchors, but no step diagnostic. The cause remains unknown; this review did not run a browser or acceptance flow.
verdict_a_runtime.limit: Only a fresh run of the instrumented runner can show which allowlisted step was reached. The earlier error was discarded, so no click, popup, or navigation cause is inferred.

evidence: The diagnostic object is built from fixed group and step labels, an integer candidate count, booleans, and a bounded 0-2 stable-hit sample count. It stores no expected or actual URL, page text, exception message, stack, or arbitrary DOM value.

The activation still requires exactly one scoped anchor, exact href equality, target=_blank, two stable hit-tested samples with a positive click area, successful pointer press and release, a new page event, and the exact expected destination URL. Assertion errors are rethrown after attaching diagnostics; the top-level catch keeps the report unverified and copies only the diagnostic object.

The change wraps existing assertions and interaction steps; it adds no success target, skips no assertion, and changes no timeout. The metadata target remains appended only after both link activations resolve successfully.
limitations: sourcePageStillOpen and sourceUrlUnchanged are diagnostic observations only; they are not asserted as acceptance predicates. Do not claim source-tab preservation from this target, and do not treat this as a weakening because those predicates were not previously acceptance gates.

A thrown error during opened.close() in finally could replace the original activation error and prevent the already-attached diagnostic from reaching the top-level catch. The report would still be unverified, but the added detail could be lost on that cleanup failure.
No live run has confirmed the new fields, their values, or diagnostic completeness.

review_scope: Reviewed b043645e and the preserved run 013 receipt/diagnosis. No source changes, browser, heavy test, build, auth session, data write, or push was performed.
